beats.summary: Office employees dress up in Halloween costumes and interact with each other.

evidence.snippet: Kelly (dressed as Carrie Bradshaw): Wow you guys look amazing.
Pam is dressed as Charlie Chaplin

beats.summary: Michael and Holly prepare for a road trip as Holly is being transferred back to Nashua by Corporate.

evidence.snippet: Michael: When Corporate found out that we were dating, they decided they were going to transfer Holly back to her old branch, in Nashua, New Hampshire.
Michael: Okay, I think we are set. We have puzzles, string for Cat's Cradles. Burned this last night. A little road trip CD. Puppets.

beats.summary: Michael and Holly discuss the transfer and their plans for the road trip.

evidence.snippet: Holly: Michael is taking a personal day to move me up.

beats.summary: Dwight wears a Cornell sweatshirt to provoke Andy, who is protective of Cornell's colors.

evidence.snippet: Andy: Remember when I jokingly yelled at you to take your sweatshirt off? Totally joking. But, you should know, those colors are sacred.

beats.summary: Jim prepares to go to New York for lunch with his brothers and Pam to celebrate their engagement.

evidence.snippet: Jim: I am off to New York. My brother Pete from Boston, and my brother Tom from New Jersey are taking Pam and I out for lunch, to celebrate the engagement.
Pam: Thanks. My costume's getting a lot of attention.

beats.summary: Pam and Jim's brothers plan a prank on Jim during lunch.

evidence.snippet: Pam: I asked Tom and Pete to come early so we could play a prank on Jim at lunch!
Pete: That's perfect. You know what would be even more hilarious? Remember that thing we did when Jim was in high school with his girlfriend?
